description: This file is a test script for Git's worktree listing functionality. It contains multiple test cases verifying behavior of 'git worktree list' under various configurations, including handling of different paths, locked states, porcelain output, and edge cases such as bare repositories and broken worktrees.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets specific git configuration for the test.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands after the test runs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the command fails, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in output, verifies presence.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Custom tool or utility used within tests (e.g., ref-store).

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp for testing commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the test repository.
